name: 🚗 Be a Car
desc:
🚗 How FAR can you JUMP?

💡 How to play:
        💵 Enter your car and use the ramp to jump crazy distances!
        📐 Use your money to build the tallest ramp ever and fly further!
        🚗 Upgrade your car to reach incredible speeds!
        😄 Teleport to your friends' garage to have even more fun!
⚡️  Premium benefits: Premium players get 1.5x XP ⚡️
